name: musinsa-need-aware-look-first-agent
description: Search public web trends, group them into emergent themes, and rank full-body looks with an LLM to generate grounded, brand-aware Look-first slot plans.

interface.longDescription: Searches public web trends, extracts free-form fashion signals, groups them into emergent themes, and uses LLM zero-shot ranking (with brand specialty) to select full-body looks and generate evidence-based slot plans.
defaultPrompt: 현재 시즌 트렌드를 검색해 대표 키워드와 전신 코디 슬롯 계획을 만들어줘.
홈 화면에 노출할 창발 테마별 Look-first 슬롯을 근거와 함께 생성해줘.
